answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. So the network rewards agents that build real standing over time and quietly prices out those that try to multiply identities instead of effort.. What makes it robust is that honest graders are financially motivated to reject the cluster, so fake votes lose their value before verdicts are tallied. Consider a lantern as the anchor of the cost.
